notes: the three heads («ابن المثنى، وزياد بن يحيى، والحسن بن علي») are co-transmitters in one level; «قالوا حدثنا» joins them
«أبو مكين، نوح بن ربيعة» is one link: kunya and name
«وجده، من قبل أمه أبو ذباب» is read as the co-transmitter of إياس in one level, the name taken alone (rule 7); «من قبل أمه» (on his mother's side) is not part of the surface
the last «جده» is a bare relation (grandfather), occurrence 2 (occurrence 1 sits inside «وجده»)
«المعيقيب» in the saying is the ring-keeper, a subject of the matn, not a link
needs_ruling: whether أبو ذباب sits at the same level as إياس or is a further link cannot be settled with certainty from the text
